name: Recordare
description: Long-term episodic memory kept by your own Recordare service: capture, recall before each turn, memory tools.

apiKey.label: API key or personal token
apiKey.help: A personal token (the agent's memory) or a client key (scopes ingest, mcp, read; the account in Agent account, or one per person)

memoryPer.label: Memory per
memoryPer.help: agent (default): one memory for this agent, the people who talk to it are participants recognised inside it; user: one memory per person (People)

defaultUser.label: Agent account
defaultUser.help: With a client key: the agent's Recordare user (memoryPer agent), or the user of turns without a channel sender (memoryPer user). Not needed with a personal token

selfSenders.label: Account holder's senders
selfSenders.help: "<channel>:<senderId>" ids that are you, the memory's "I" (e.g. "telegram:123456"); everyone else is a participant. CLI and Control UI turns are always yours

autoRecall.label: Recall before each turn
autoRecall.help: Add the relevant memories before the agent answers

tools.label: Memory tools
tools.help: Offer the recordare_* tools to the agent

groups.label: Group chats
groups.help: Capture group chats too (every member a participant)
